clue.text: Fictional captain owned landing bay

parts.note: owned means had
a dock is a bay where ships land cargo

explanation.surface: A storybook sea captain who once possessed his own landing bay.
explanation.definitionFit: Captain Haddock is Tintin's hard-drinking sea-captain companion in Hergé's comic books; the name is also a fish, the puzzle's theme.

clue.text: One new hair product gives heavenly body!

parts.note: one is the article a
gel is a styling product for hair

explanation.surface: A beauty advert promising that a new styling product will give you a gorgeous figure.
explanation.definitionFit: An angel is a celestial being, so a body from heaven; the surface reads it as a sexy figure.

clue.text: Musician stranger after last of LSD

indicators.note: after puts the stranger piece following the letter from LSD
last of picks the final letter of the abbreviation LSD

parts.note: rummer means odder, stranger (rum = odd)

explanation.surface: A musician who has gone odd after taking the drug LSD.
explanation.definitionFit: A drummer is a musician who plays the drums, a percussion player in a band.

clue.text: Modelling Southern Princess reveals fresh quality

indicators.note: modelling shapes material into a new form, so these letters are remoulded

explanation.surface: A princess from the South doing catwalk work turns out to look fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Crispness is the state of being crisp, which means fresh and firm, like new lettuce or clean air.

clue.text: Queen succeeds King over old prince as he touches inappropriately

indicators.note: succeeds means comes after, so the Queen's letters follow the rest

parts.note: GR is Georgius Rex, King George
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A royal succession story that turns into a scandal about a handsy prince.
explanation.definitionFit: A groper is a man who fondles people without consent; the answer is also an Australian fish.

clue.text: Roll-up to see American pest

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the butt of a cannabis joint, a hand-rolled cigarette
second meaning: US shortening of cockroach

explanation.walkthrough: Two senses of one word joined by 'to see'; it is also a freshwater fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang uses the word both for the stub of a smoked joint and, in America, for the cockroach insect.

clue.text: Caught Nepali flying bird

indicators.note: flying suggests letters scattered in the air, so they are rearranged

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A man from Nepal caught a bird in flight.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelican is a large water bird with a throat pouch for scooping up fish.

clue.text: Once more stimulates naughtily aware toy boys

indicators.note: acting naughtily means misbehaving, so the letters are thrown out of order

parts.note: Ken is Barbie's boyfriend doll, a literal toy boy

explanation.surface: Someone's passion is reignited by knowing young lovers.
explanation.walkthrough: A toy boy is a much younger male lover; here it is a toy that is a boy, Barbie's Ken.
explanation.definitionFit: To reawaken is to rouse again, so it stimulates once more a feeling that had gone dormant.

clue.text: Sloth's carrying painful condition to rodents

indicators.note: carrying means holding something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the ai is the three-toed sloth; sloth's read as plural ais
gout is a painful inflammation of the joints

explanation.surface: A slow animal with gout passing it on to rodents.
explanation.walkthrough: AI, the three-toed sloth, is a crossword favourite; the 's makes it plural.
explanation.definitionFit: Agoutis are burrowing South American rodents related to guinea pigs.

clue.text: Return boat trip took in Mexican flowers

indicators.note: return means going back, so the letters are read from the end

parts.note: a sail is a trip in a boat
had means took, as in had a drink

explanation.surface: On a return boat journey someone admired Mexican blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Dahlias are garden flowers native to Mexico, which made the dahlia its national flower.

clue.text: Quietly directed to another agency and promoted

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
referred means passed on to another body to deal with

explanation.surface: A case was quietly passed to another department and someone got promoted.
explanation.definitionFit: Preferred in the older sense means advanced to a higher office or rank, as in preferment.

clue.text: Secretive person, quiet but inwardly upset

indicators.note: only the inside of the word is disturbed: its two middle letters swap

parts.note: calm means quiet, peaceful

explanation.surface: A tight-lipped person seems quiet but is churning inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who clams up stays silent, so a clam is informally a person who keeps secrets; also a shellfish.

clue.text: Precarious seat inside upper chamber

indicators.note: inside says the letters sit within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A wobbly seat in the upper house of parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: A perch is a high, often insecure place to sit, like a bird's roosting bar.

clue.text: Criticise cold starters of raw adzuki beans

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

indicators.note: starters are the first parts, so take the initial letter of each word

explanation.surface: Someone pans a cold starter of raw adzuki beans.
explanation.definitionFit: To crab is informal for to complain or find fault, carp at someone.

clue.text: Part of Oscar celebration is unusual

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Winning an Academy Award and celebrating it is a rare event.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarce means rare or in short supply, so a scarce thing is unusual; definition reads as 'is scarce'.

clue.text: Develop religious group that is tax inclusive

parts.note: a cult is a religious sect

indicators.note: inclusive means containing, so the tax goes within the other piece

parts.note: i.e. is id est, that is
VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: A sect's prices are quoted including tax as it grows.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is Britain's sales tax, value added tax.
explanation.definitionFit: To cultivate is to foster or nurture something so it grows, as with a skill or a crop.

clue.text: Patriarch embraces Liberal struggle

indicators.note: embraces means holds within arms, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a patriarch is the founder of a family or line

explanation.surface: An old head of a family hugs a Liberal and wrestles with him.
explanation.definitionFit: To flounder is to thrash about or struggle clumsily; it is also a flatfish.

clue.text: Gulf state protecting mafia head shoots official investigator

indicators.note: protecting means surrounding as a guard, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: Oman is a state on the Arabian Gulf

indicators.note: head means the first letter of mafia

parts.note: buds are young shoots on a plant

explanation.surface: A Gulf nation shelters a mafia boss who opens fire.
explanation.definitionFit: An ombudsman is an official appointed to investigate complaints against public bodies or companies.

clue.text: Daily injecting sulphur that may remove impurities

indicators.note: a daily injecting sulphur takes it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a daily is a cleaner who comes in each day
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: A daily help dosing with sulphur to clean things up.
explanation.walkthrough: A daily is British for a domestic cleaner who comes in each day.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleanser is a product such as a face wash whose job is to take dirt and impurities away.

clue.text: A few lie about old landlady

indicators.note: about means around, here in the sense of turned round and jumbled

explanation.surface: Few people tell untruths about an old innkeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: An alewife was historically a woman who kept an alehouse; it is also a herring-like fish.

clue.text: Most degenerate 25 on the radio is in Paris

indicators.note: on the radio means heard rather than seen, so the pieces are taken by their sound

parts.note: 25 across is BASS, the singer's voice, pronounced 'bayss' like the first syllable of the answer
est is French for is

explanation.surface: A cross-reference clue: the lowest sort of person mentioned on air in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: The bass voice at 25 is said 'bayss', which is how the answer's first syllable BAS sounds; the French for 'is' finishes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Basest is the superlative of base, meaning low or morally contemptible.

clue.text: Cry before Virgin Ascending then get real

indicators.note: before puts the cry ahead of the rest

parts.note: to sob is to cry

indicators.note: ascending means going up, so in a down clue the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: pure means chaste, virginal

explanation.surface: Weep, then rise up like a Virgin airline flight, and face facts.
explanation.definitionFit: To sober up is to become clear-headed and realistic, which is what get real tells someone to do.

clue.text: Milligan possibly loses his head to infantry weapon

indicators.note: his head is the first letter of Spike, which is dropped

parts.note: Spike Milligan, the comedian, is one bearer of the name

explanation.surface: Milligan goes mad and loses his head to a soldier's weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: Spike Milligan was a British comedian of The Goon Show.
explanation.definitionFit: A pike is a long spear formerly carried by foot soldiers; it is also a predatory fish.

clue.text: China dismisses Republican evil-doer

indicators.note: dismisses means sends away, so one letter is removed

parts.note: china means mate, a friend, from rhyming slang china plate

explanation.surface: Beijing sacks a Republican evil-doer, a political spat.
explanation.walkthrough: China looks like the country; it is cockney rhyming slang, china plate = mate.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiend is a wicked or cruel person, a devil in human form.

clue.text: Chance fellow, one who could be called lucky

parts.words: one who could be called lucky
parts.note: Lucky Luke is the comic-book cowboy, so a Luke may be called Lucky

explanation.surface: A random man is the sort people call lucky.
explanation.definitionFit: A fluke is a lucky accident, a stroke of chance; it is also a flatfish.

clue.text: Singer requires brasses from time to time

indicators.note: from time to time means now and then, so every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A vocalist who sometimes needs the brass section.
explanation.definitionFit: A bass is a man with the lowest singing voice in a choir; it is also a fish.

clue.text: Winter boot created by society duchess

parts.note: Kate Middleton was Duchess of Cambridge

explanation.surface: A designer snow boot launched by a society duchess.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice skate is a boot with a blade worn on ice in winter; it is also a ray fish.

clue.text: Tire of rich Joe backing continental alliance in recession

parts.note: fat means rich, as in a fat profit

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the letters are turned round

parts.note: a GI Joe is an American soldier

indicators.note: in recession means receding, moving back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: the EU is the European Union

explanation.surface: Grow weary of a wealthy American backing Europe during an economic slump.
explanation.definitionFit: Fatigue as a verb means to exhaust or weary, the same as to tire someone out.

clue.text: Italian maybe drunk in Burma

indicators.note: drunk means unsteady, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: An Italian, perhaps, the worse for wear in Burma.
explanation.definitionFit: An Umbrian comes from Umbria, a region of central Italy, so is one example of an Italian.

clue.text: Fair about the French football team?

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece is wrapped round the other

parts.note: even means fair, level
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Is the French football team playing fairly?
explanation.definitionFit: A football side has eleven players, so the team is often called the eleven.

clue.text: Child's play for amateur photographer

parts.note: snap is a children's card game
per means for, as in so much per head

explanation.surface: Taking snapshots is easy for a hobby photographer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Child's play' looks like an idiom for easy; it is the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapper is someone who takes snaps, casual photographs; it is also a fish.
